parsed.scene_description: A wide-angle view down an aisle in a large, well-lit warehouse. High metal racks line both sides, filled with stacked boxes. Yellow and black forklifts are parked or moving along the aisle. Yellow protective bollards are placed at intervals. The floor is smooth concrete. Distant figures in red clothing are visible near the far end.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Yellow and black forklift on left side of aisle, partially visible. It has a black seat and 'STILL' branding on rear. Positioned near rack labeled '4'.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Another yellow and black forklift further down the aisle, facing away from camera. It's positioned between racks labeled '4' and '5'.

objects.label: warehouse rack
objects.observation: High metal shelving unit on left, marked with yellow '4'. Loaded with white boxes on wooden pallets. Partially occludes forklift.

objects.label: warehouse rack
objects.observation: High metal shelving unit on right, marked with yellow '4'. Contains stacked boxes. Supported by concrete pillar. Bollards are in front.

objects.label: yellow bollard
objects.observation: Yellow cylindrical bollard with black base, located on right side aisle near rack '4'. Appears freestanding on concrete floor.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Figure wearing red jacket walking in distance down center aisle. Unclear if male or female. Near forklifts and racks.
